analogy.rationale: Oxidizing agents generate reactive oxygen species and deplete thiols, so oxidative stress inducers should share the strongest transcriptional signature (Nrf2/ARE, stress-response genes); antioxidants act on the same redox axis in the opposite direction, while chelators and DNA-damaging or translation-stress agents overlap partially through metal/redox and stress-response programs.
